description: A React component 'ServerTrans' that handles translation rendering with support for HTML tags, component interpolation, and fallback content, without using React Context.

classes.name: ServerTrans
classes.description: A React functional component for translation with HTML and component interpolation support.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Utility to check if a value is a non-null object.

methods.name: parseArrayComponents
methods.description: Parses translation content with array-based component tags like <0>content</0>.

methods.name: getTextBetweenTags
methods.description: Helper to extract inner text between matching tags, handling nested tags.

methods.name: parseObjectComponents
methods.description: Parses translation content with object-based component tags like <tag>content</tag> or {{tag}}.

methods.name: parseHtmlTags
methods.description: Parses HTML tags within translation content, converting them into React elements.
